name: 吉塔
objective:
ENERGY ENGINEERING is a branch of Engineering science that deals with production, transformation, transmission, storage and use of energy and is the most recent engineering disciplines to emerge. 
This course 'ENERGY ENGINEERING’ is a basic course taught entirely in English. 
The aim of this course is to provide introductory knowledge to students who have not studied Environmental Energy Science as a subject. 
Students can gain basic knowledge about Energy sources, production of energy, Energy Management, and most importantly about Bioenergy Engineering. 
This deals with sustainable methods of producing clean energy and thereby preventing hazardous environmental issues through significant energy efficiency improvements and sustainable use of resources.
This course also has an important objective of motivating non-native students to improve their English language skills like conversing, discussing and writing assignments in English.
These practices will help them deliver better English presentations and also enhance their thesis and paper writing abilities.
schedule:
Week 1: Energy Engineering - Introduction and Basics
Week 2: Basics of Energy Engineering- 1
Week 3: Basics of Energy Engineering- 2
Week 4: Energy Farming
Week 5: Bio Energy Engineering 
Week 6: Energy Management
Week 7:Energy Organizations
Week 8: Energy Laws and Regulations
Week 9: Midterm Exam (April 20, 2026)
Week 10: Bioelectrochemical Systems 
Week 11: Carbon cycle and Footprints
Week 12: Fuel cells and their types
Week 13: Carbon Sequestration
Week 14: Nuclear Energy
Week 15: Hydrogen Energy 
Week 16: Methanol Energy
Week 17: Energy Tourism
Week 18: Final Exam (June 22, 2026)

1. The students of this class will be separated into groups for weekly presentation purposes and every week the Teacher will assign a topic for the presentation.
2. In every class, the Teacher will initially finish the power point presentation
3. Then one person from every group has to give his/her presentation
4.The students can use Powerpoint and YouTube videos to make their presentations interesting.
scorePolicy:
The Teacher will conduct one Midterm exam and one Final exam throughout the semester
The questions for the exams will be from the power-point presentation of the Teacher. 
The total score of exam will be for 100 marks, in which the Teacher will consider the assignment marks, class attendance and the weekly presentation of every student.
The final score will be for 100% and it will be a sum of evaluations as 50% (from the final written exam) 25% (from the Midterm exam score) 15% (from the class presentations) 10% (from class attendance and attentiveness).
materials:
The Teacher will not use any textbooks/bibliography materials for the class.
The students will have to study the Powerpoint presentations prepared and taught by the Teacher in every class.
consultation: The Teacher of this course will follow all rules and practices to make the class interesting.The students will have a new experience in learning English.After the Teacher’s presentation, the students will give their presentations.
